title: Wonderful
text: Louis was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate. We learned so much. I would highly recommend this tour.
author: Amanda_G

title: Unique Experience-No crowds!
text: Being originally from New Orleans, my husband and I have a unique interest and appreciation for cemeteries. This tour may not be as well known as others, but it is just as fascinating for the artistry and architecture. If you have extra time you should definitely go see this cemetery built into a mountain.
author: Rebecca_M

title: Exception Tour and Guide
text: We have used Viator for numerous excursions in several countries, and Ono is by far the best guide we have had the pleasure of spending the day with! He was extremely knowledgeable, personable, and willing to tailor the tour to our specific interests. His flexibility and enthusiasm made the experience truly memorable. We highly recommend Ono to anyone looking for an exceptional tour experience!
author: Beverly_H

title: Beautiful, expansive...
text: Beautiful, expansive cemetery. Many beautiful statues, tombs, and interesting history. Too big for a casual walk so very helpful to have a guide to show you around. Onno was an excellent guide, very friendly, knowledgeable and fun
author: Richard_E

title: Best of Barcelona
text: Lots of walking on uneven terrain but so worth it! What a beautiful and fascinating spot. Onno was a knowledgeable and thoughtful guide. Can’t recommend him enough! Go on a Saturday and you’ll get to see the funeral carriage museum. Tiny but astonishing.
author: PaulaJayne_W

title: Wonderful unique experience - must do tour!
text: Best tour in Barcelona. The Montjuic Cemetery tour with Onno is terrific. Onno is the most knowledgeable tour guide I’ve ever known, as well as kind and fun. Tour operations were very good - responsive and flexible. The best part is being at Montjuic Cemetery — a Hidden gem that is beautiful, tranquil, and full of a wealth of history about the people and culture of Barcelona. I’ve done tours on 4 continents and this really is tops. If I could only do one thing in Barcelona, it would be this tour. Highly recommend.
author: Emiley_L

title: Awesome experience
text: The tour was fantastic! Our guide was super knowledgeable and definitely helped us understand the history and see the architectural highlights of the huge cemetery. It was a pleasure to learn from him and was nice to escape the crowds as we immersed ourselves in this unique tour about Barcelona’s history.
author: kirstent784

title: OneFam Hostel Tour
text: This was a very awesome experience! Shoutout Onno for his enthusiasm and informative commentary! I learned so much and I am grateful for his kindness.
author: isabella s

title: A “handy” take on the Vastness
text: Montjuic Cemetery is a vast Architecture of power, memory, and legacy. In a monumental scale that requires a real connoisseur to tackle it. Omni our guide was that person, knowledgeable, curious, and able to point out the sites of interest all while sprinkling the local history and important information about the monuments and the people in them. A must do if you are in Barcelona. Onno made it easy and interesting to navigate.
author: Doris B

title: A place to visit
text: Very interesting. Very friendly. Very good knowledge of graveyard hidden places. Meeting place easy to find. Definitely recommend.
author: jacky_h
